audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer calls this EVEN at 5.5/10 and the level chart hands Karma levels 1 and 2+ items, while the packet win rate is 29.41% and every content-layer why says Urgot wins outright.
audit.why: Two layers disagreed with each other and with the data. Packet levelChart is Skill, then Urgot for rows 1-6.
audit.corrected: HARD, 8/10 difficulty, Urgot carry threat 8/10; chart set to Skill / Urgot x6 on both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys claimed a Karma-favoured curve ('the lane is a toll booth and you own it'), ignoring Purge scaling and the level-6 execute.
audit.why: Urgot's W (Purge) drops from 12s/40 mana at rank 1 to 0s/0 mana at rank 5, and R (Fear Beyond Death) is a 100/85/70s execute. Karma's Mantra is online at level 1, so she has no level-6 spike to answer it.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[0..6].why around Purge ranks, Disdain's 16s rank-1 cooldown, and the R execute.

audit.whatIsWrong: No concrete interaction or cooldown anywhere (packet: sequencingCues 0). breakdown.cooldowns said 'count it out loud' with no number.
audit.why: Disdain is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s at 475 range; Purge is 490 range and free at rank 5; Karma's W (Focused Resolve) needs 675 range and 12s, so she must enter Purge range to use her only lockdown. That is the decisive interaction and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: Stated the 675-vs-490 range trap, gave Disdain's real cooldown window, and keyed the E shield to the flip rather than poke.

audit.why: Disdain down for 16s at rank 1 is the only safe window to step up.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'His Fear Beyond Death' as a probable wrong ability name.
audit.why: False positive — Fear Beyond Death is Urgot's real R name in the kit file.
audit.corrected: No change; name left as written.

edits.before: Q poke at level 1 is among the best in the game — chunk Urgot on every last-hit and start the Mantra economy.
edits.after: Mantra is up at level 1 so RQ matches his opening, but Corrosive Charge trades back and neither side owns it.

edits.before: W tether threatens the root — anyone who steps to you early eats Q-W and donates the trade.
edits.after: Purge comes online soon and his Q slow sets it up — Focused Resolve needs 675 range you can't hold.

edits.before: Full kit: E shield-speed makes you untouchable in short trades. Mantra-Q (RQ) on cooldown gaps is a third of his HP.
edits.after: Purge at rank 3 costs 20 mana on a 6s cooldown — he walks you down and out-DPSes any tether you try at 675 range.

edits.before: Spam the RQ slow-field on his farming spots and keep your shield for Disdain (Flip) — the lane is a toll booth and you own it.
edits.after: Poke can't outpace his sustain and W shred, and Disdain punishes any over-step — Inspire is your only answer, hold it for the flip.

edits.before: No new ultimate at 6 — your Mantra has been online since level 1. His spike is the danger window: respect it.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death executes you under the threshold and suppresses — your Inspire speed cannot carry you out.

edits.before: First item amplifies the RQ chunk — keep him under 60% and the lane stays yours by default.
edits.after: Cleaver Urgot walks through your poke — one flip into Purge and R kills before Mantra resets.

edits.before: You drift toward utility now — peel, shield, and speed your carries while the RQ poke softens objectives.
edits.after: He out-scales you outright — percent-HP shotguns end duels, so your value is peel, shields and speed, never a 1v1.

edits.before: A toll booth he can't afford — RQ every step-up and tether the one chase he tries.
edits.after: You don't win this duel — poke from max range and hold Inspire for his Disdain flip.

edits.before: Poke him off the wave and root the one mistake he makes. Keep one eye on Disdain (Flip) and one on the wave, in that order.
edits.after: Poke from max Q range and step back; Disdain (Flip) is 16s at rank 1 — every forward step waits for its downtime.

edits.before: Open the toll booth: Q every last-hit, RQ the cooldown gaps, and hold E strictly for Disdain (Flip). The lane is yours until he spikes.
edits.after: Q every last-hit from max range, step back, and hold E strictly for Disdain (Flip) — his Purge shotgun wins any close trade.

edits.before: - Urgot Disdain (Flip): matchup-defining — His flip engage — sidestep it and he has no way to start. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E shield has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Urgot Disdain (Flip): 16s at rank 1, 14s at rank 5 — his only engage. Step up only in that window. - Purge at rank 5 is a 0-cooldown, 0-mana shred: never stand inside 490 range. - Hold E for the flip, not for poke.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Urgot carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10, Urgot carry threat 8/10.
